'''Operation Third Law''' was the military codename for [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] mission to secure a loan that would help replenish the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel fleet]] from the banking world of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].

She was accompanied by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and a [[Human replica droid]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] finance minister [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] [[Tardi]].
